errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis starts at 1.7 and ends at 10.8. These are the minimum and maximum data values of the bars, not the range of the axis, which is from 0 to 12.
The description omits the actual range of the y-axis (0 to 12) and the tick mark interval (every 2 units), which are explicitly requested by the prompt.
